content: Recent clinical trials, including DAPA-CKD, CREDENCE, and EMPA-KIDNEY, have provided robust evidence supporting the effectiveness of SGLT2 inhibitors in mitigating cardiovascular and renal complications in individuals diagnosed with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and chronic kidney disease (CKD). These benefits are particularly pronounced in patients with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of 20 mL/min/1.73 m² or higher.
